lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with a dense field of smaller, stochastic spots located anterior to the first slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance are present, with the primary circular spots acting as nodes at the intersection of these vertical bands and horizontal axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the dorsal-lateral interface, originating above the gill slits and defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with highlights on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct white horizontal linear feature is visible on the upper flank, originating superior to the third gill slit and extending towards the posterior.
other_distinctive_markers: A small high-chroma yellow object is localized at the ventral base of the pectoral fin; additionally, the pectoral fin displays a dense arrangement of small high-luminance spots across its visible surface.
